auditor: Independent script without importing scorer, runner, or application

method_review.selection: Outcome-independent seeded SHA-256 filename ranking; exact reproduction verified.
method_review.reference: Scored against the original dataset normalized field, checked byte-for-byte against the pinned TSV. Independently normalizing raw references gives the same strings for all 32 clips.
method_review.normalization: NFKC then casefold; keep Unicode letter/mark/number categories; replace all else with spaces and collapse whitespace. No numeric-word or lexical spelling equivalence.
method_review.metrics: Per-clip minimum Levenshtein distance; micro-aggregate errors divided by reference units, not average clip rates. CER counts spaces.
method_review.execution: Inspected runner launches actual snapshotted CLI in fresh sequential subprocesses, no resume; explicit en, CPU int8, beam 5, VAD off, previous-text conditioning off, offline local model.
limitations: 32 recordings but only 31 distinct source sentence IDs.
Read speech and explicit language only; not spontaneous speech, long-recording accuracy, language autodetection, or representative population performance.
Public official test partition does not prove exclusion from Whisper pretraining.
Case/punctuation are discarded; correctness is not semantic accuracy, and alternate spellings can count as errors.
Saved metadata and logs establish recorded provenance, not an independent network packet trace.
